name: 5N Plus Semiconductors
old_description: Moteur de performance essentiel aux technologies et produits de tous les jours
about:
5N Plus is headquartered in Montréal, Québec, and was founded in 2000. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX:VNP) and operates production and R&D centers across North America, Europe, and Asia, including a major manufacturing facility in St. George, Utah.

The company produces specialized semiconductors and high-performance materials using proprietary technologies. Its product portfolio includes germanium wafers, cadmium telluride (CdTe) for terrestrial solar cells, gallium arsenide components for defense applications, cadmium zinc telluride (CZT) for medical imaging and industrial detection, bismuth-based alloys, and active pharmaceutical ingredients. A 50% expansion of the St. George facility is underway to increase capacity for defense, space solar, and medical markets.

5N Plus serves critical industries such as space solar power, terrestrial renewable energy, medical imaging and detection, pharmaceuticals, technical materials, and defense. Its materials are often the critical component in customers' end products, including satellites, solar panels, medical detectors, and defense systems.

Since its inception, 5N Plus has emphasized sustainable growth and circular economy principles, leveraging world-class R&D and exclusive processes to transform metals into value-added specialized materials. The company states that its proprietary technologies and advanced manufacturing capabilities enable it to deliver critical materials that are essential to its clients' technologies.
